description: Elections Commission - Order under Section 38(3) of the (Local Authority Election Ordinance) Kurunegala District
categorisation: This gazette content specifically deals with the postponement and rescheduling of local authority elections in the Kurunegala District due to funding issues. It references election notifications, nomination periods, poll dates, and the role of the Election Commission - all of which fall under electoral processes and related matters as defined in Type 7 (Elections Gazettes). The content focuses on election administration rather than government personnel changes or structural reorganizations.
